Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Mode: matcap: look up colour from a matcap image using the normal's XY. lights: procedural key, fill and rim lighting with specular.
Normalenc: signed: in1 normals are already -1..1. packed: in1 normals are encoded 0..1 and get decoded.
Colormix: How strongly the colour/albedo on in3 multiplies the shading. 0 = ignore in3, 1 = fully multiplied.
Brightness: Output gain applied to the shaded result. 1 = unchanged.
Background: Where normals are empty (zero length): transparent leaves transparent black, color fills with the in3 colour.
Matcaprotate: Rotates the matcap lookup around the view axis, in degrees (-180 to 180).
Keyazimuth: Horizontal angle of the key light in degrees. 0 = from the camera, negative = from the left, positive = from the right.
Keyelevation: Height of the key light in degrees. 0 = horizon, 90 = straight above.
Keyintensity: Brightness of the key light diffuse term. 0 turns the key off.
Keycolor: Colour of the key light (also tints the specular highlight).
Fillintensity: Brightness of the soft fill light on the opposite side of the key. 0 turns the fill off.
Rimintensity: Brightness of the rim light on silhouette edges facing away from the camera. 0 turns it off.
Rimpower: Rim falloff sharpness. Low values give a wide soft rim, high values (5+) a thin tight edge.
Ambient: Constant light added everywhere normals exist, so shadowed areas are not pure black.
Specamount: Strength of the key light's specular highlight. 0 = matte.
Specpower: Specular shininess exponent. Higher values (100+) give a small tight highlight, low values a broad one.
Wrap: Wrap lighting: lets diffuse light wrap past the terminator for softer shadows. 0 = hard Lambert, 1 = very soft.
